title: CityPlus About
description: Editorial About section with one story and one image.

body.default:
Founded in 2022 in Rhodes, CityPlus Hotels was born from the vision of three brothers who shared a passion for hospitality and a desire to create a new generation of city hotels. Built on family values, dedication, and a personal approach, our company represents the perfect balance between authentic Greek hospitality and modern travel experiences.

As a family-owned business, we believe that the smallest details create the biggest impressions. Every decision we make is guided by our commitment to providing comfortable spaces, thoughtful services, and a welcoming environment where every guest feels at home.

Our journey began in the heart of Rhodes, a destination where history, culture, nature, and modern lifestyle come together. Inspired by the island’s unique character, we created a hospitality concept designed for today’s travelers, guests who seek comfort, convenience, authentic experiences, and a connection with the destination they visit.

From our first property, our goal has always been to build more than just a hotel. We aim to create a recognizable hospitality brand based on quality, consistency, and genuine care. The CityPlus philosophy reflects our belief that every stay should offer something extra: more comfort, more convenience, more experiences, and more reasons to return.

Driven by our family spirit and entrepreneurial mindset, we continue to grow with the ambition of expanding CityPlus Hotels into a wider hotel collection across Greece and beyond. Each future destination will carry the same values that shaped our beginning in Rhodes: personal hospitality, modern design, and attention to every guest’s needs.

CityPlus Hotels is not only a place to stay. It is a family story, a passion for hospitality, and a journey that has just begun.
